classes.name: Cardboard
classes.bin: Blue bin — dry waste (or hand to the kabadiwala / MRF)
steps: Empty and scrape out food/liquid residue.
Rinse quickly if sticky; let it dry — wet recyclables spoil the batch.
Flatten bottles and cartons to save space.
Keep caps on (most Indian MRFs accept them with the bottle).
Put in the blue dry-waste bin or sell to a local kabadiwala / scrap dealer.
do_not: Do not bag recyclables in a black bag — collectors treat black bags as mixed waste.
Do not mix with wet kitchen waste.

classes.name: Mixed trash
classes.bin: Grey/black bin — reject waste (or the mixed-waste bin)
steps: Make sure it is genuinely non-recyclable (multi-layer wrappers, laminated pouches, ceramics).
Empty liquids and wrap sharp edges.
Put in the reject/mixed bin — never in the wet bin.
do_not: Do not burn plastic waste — releases dioxins and is an offence under SWM Rules.
